paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Base LLaMA-3.1-8B & Mistral-7B-v0.3 in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: The image displays a donut chart illustrating the win rates (%) of three large language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and Mistral-7B-v0.3—in generating empathetic responses, as judged by Gemini. The chart is divided into four segments, with the largest segment in dark red representing GPT-4o at 98.4%, followed by a slightly smaller dark blue segment for GPT-4o at 96.8% (possibly indicating a different variant or metric, though labeled identically). The remaining two segments are much smaller: a light blue segment for LLaMA at 3.2% and a very thin gray segment for Mistral at 1.2%. The central white circle contains the label "Win rate (%)". Each segment is labeled with its corresponding model name and percentage, connected by lines to their respective slices. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of GPT-4o, with the two smaller models accounting for only a negligible portion of the total win rate.
